  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   * Calculate the final price of a booking after evaluating the customer's membership reward.
   * Algorithm:
   * 1. If customer is null or bookingTime is null, return this trip's original price.
   * 2. If customer.membershipPackage is null, return this trip's original price.
   * 3. If the membership package does not contain the DISCOUNTS award, return the original price.
   * 4. Verify that the booking is made at least 24 hours before this trip's departure time.
   * 5. If the discount condition is satisfied, compute discountedPrice = price * 0.8.
   * 6. Round the result to one decimal place.
   * 7. Return the discounted price; otherwise return the original price.
   * Related Features:
   * - price
   * - departureDate
   * - departureTime
   * Related Classes: Customer, MembershipPackage, Award, EDate
   * Input:
   * - customer: the booking customer.
   * - bookingTime: booking timestamp string.
   * Output:
   * - double
   * - Final price of the trip, rounded to one decimal place.
   * - If the customer, membership package, booking time, or reward condition is invalid or missing, return the original trip price.
   * Pre-condition:
   * - Trip exists and has a valid price and departure time.
   * - bookingTime and departure time can be compared chronologically.
   * Post-condition:
   * - No persistent state is changed.
   * - The returned value is either the original price or the discounted price rounded to one decimal.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public double calculateDiscountedPrice(final Customer customer, final String bookingTime)
  {
    if (customer == null || bookingTime == null)
    {
      return price;
    }
    MembershipPackage membershipPackage = customer.getMembershipPackage();
    if (membershipPackage == null || !membershipPackage.hasAward(Award.DISCOUNTS))
    {
      return price;
    }
    if (departureDate == null || departureTime == null)
    {
      return price;
    }

    try
    {
      Date bookingDateTime = javax.xml.bind.DatatypeConverter.parseDateTime(bookingTime).getTime();
      Calendar departureCalendar = Calendar.getInstance();
      departureCalendar.setTime(departureDate);

      String[] timeParts = departureTime.split(":");
      if (timeParts.length < 2)
      {
        return price;
      }
      int depHour = Integer.parseInt(timeParts[0].trim());
      int depMinute = Integer.parseInt(timeParts[1].trim());

      departureCalendar.set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, depHour);
      departureCalendar.set(Calendar.MINUTE, depMinute);
      departureCalendar.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0);
      departureCalendar.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);

      long diffMillis = departureCalendar.getTimeInMillis() - bookingDateTime.getTime();
      if (diffMillis < 24L * 60L * 60L * 1000L)
      {
        return price;
      }

      double discountedPrice = price * 0.8;
      return Math.round(discountedPrice * 10.0) / 10.0;
    }
    catch (Exception e)
    {
      return price;
    }
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   * Compute the reward points earned by a customer during a given month for bookings on this trip.
   * Algorithm:
   * 1. If customer is null or currentMonth is null, return 0.
   * 2. If customer.membershipPackage is null, return 0.
   * 3. If the membership package does not contain the POINTS award, return 0.
   * 4. Initialize totalPoints = 0.
   * 5. For each booking in this trip's bookings:
   *    - If booking.customer equals the given customer and booking.isInMonth(currentMonth) is true, add booking.numberOfSeats * 5 to totalPoints.
   * 6. Return totalPoints.
   * Related Features:
   * - bookings
   * Related Classes: Booking, Customer, MembershipPackage, Award
   * Input:
   * - customer: the customer whose points are being computed.
   * - currentMonth: month identifier, typically "YYYY-MM".
   * Output:
   * - int
   * - Reward points accumulated from this trip's bookings in the requested month.
   * Pre-condition:
   * - Trip exists.
   * - bookings list is initialized.
   * - customer and currentMonth are valid for comparison.
   * Post-condition:
   * - No state is modified.
   * - Only bookings owned by the given customer, whose booking date falls in the requested month, and whose customer's membership package contains POINTS are counted.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public int calculateMonthlyPoints(final Customer customer, final String currentMonth)
  {
    if (customer == null || currentMonth == null)
    {
      return 0;
    }
    MembershipPackage membershipPackage = customer.getMembershipPackage();
    if (membershipPackage == null || !membershipPackage.hasAward(Award.POINTS))
    {
      return 0;
    }

    int totalPoints = 0;
    if (bookings != null)
    {
      for (Booking booking : bookings)
      {
        if (booking != null && customer.equals(booking.getCustomer()) && booking.isInMonth(currentMonth))
        {
          totalPoints += booking.getNumberOfSeats() * 5;
        }
      }
    }
    return totalPoints;
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   * Reserve a specified number of seats from this trip's available inventory.
   * Algorithm:
   * 1. If num <= 0, return false.
   * 2. Compute remaining seats as numberOfSeats - getBookedSeats().
   * 3. If num > remaining seats, return false.
   * 4. Increase the booked seat total by num via this trip's bookings/booking records.
   * 5. Return true.
   * Related Features:
   * - numberOfSeats
   * - bookings
   * Related Classes: Booking
   * Input:
   * - num: number of seats to reserve, must be positive.
   * Output:
   * - boolean
   * - true if the seats were successfully reserved; otherwise false.
   * Pre-condition:
   * - Trip exists.
   * - numberOfSeats is a non-negative capacity value.
   * - Bookings collection is initialized.
   * Post-condition:
   * - On success, the trip's effective booked seat count increases by num.
   * - On failure, no inventory changes are made.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public boolean bookSeats(final int num)
  {
    if (num <= 0)
    {
      return false;
    }
    int remainingSeats = numberOfSeats - getBookedSeats();
    if (num > remainingSeats)
    {
      return false;
    }
    Booking booking = RideshareFactory.eINSTANCE.createBooking();
    booking.setNumberOfSeats(num);
    booking.setTrip(this);
    getBookings().add(booking);
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   * Determine whether this trip's time interval conflicts with another proposed time interval.
   * Algorithm:
   * 1. If newDepartureTime or newArrivalTime is null, return false.
   * 2. If this trip's departureTime or arrivalTime is null, return false.
   * 3. Parse this trip's departureTime and arrivalTime and the provided times into comparable time values.
   * 4. If the proposed interval is invalid, return false.
   * 5. Determine overlap using strict interval intersection:
   *    - Conflict exists when the two intervals share any positive-length time intersection.
   *    - If one interval ends exactly when the other starts, return false.
   * 6. Return true if the intervals overlap; otherwise return false.
   * Related Features:
   * - departureTime
   * - arrivalTime
   * Related Classes: None
   * Input:
   * - newDepartureTime: proposed departure time as a string.
   * - newArrivalTime: proposed arrival time as a string.
   * Output:
   * - boolean
   * - true if the current trip conflicts with the proposed interval; otherwise false.
   * Pre-condition:
   * - Current trip has departureTime and arrivalTime values that can be compared.
   * - Input times are in the same time format as stored values.
   * Post-condition:
   * - No state is changed.
   * - Boundary-adjacent intervals are treated as non-conflicting.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public boolean isTimeConflicting(final String newDepartureTime, final String newArrivalTime)
  {
    if (newDepartureTime == null || newArrivalTime == null || departureTime == null || arrivalTime == null)
    {
      return false;
    }
    try
    {
      String[] currentDepParts = departureTime.split(":");
      String[] currentArrParts = arrivalTime.split(":");
      String[] newDepParts = newDepartureTime.split(":");
      String[] newArrParts = newArrivalTime.split(":");
      if (currentDepParts.length < 2 || currentArrParts.length < 2 || newDepParts.length < 2 || newArrParts.length < 2)
      {
        return false;
      }

      int currentDep = Integer.parseInt(currentDepParts[0].trim()) * 60 + Integer.parseInt(currentDepParts[1].trim());
      int currentArr = Integer.parseInt(currentArrParts[0].trim()) * 60 + Integer.parseInt(currentArrParts[1].trim());
      int proposedDep = Integer.parseInt(newDepParts[0].trim()) * 60 + Integer.parseInt(newDepParts[1].trim());
      int proposedArr = Integer.parseInt(newArrParts[0].trim()) * 60 + Integer.parseInt(newArrParts[1].trim());

      if (currentDep >= currentArr || proposedDep >= proposedArr)
      {
        return false;
      }

      return currentDep < proposedArr && proposedDep < currentArr;
    }
    catch (Exception e)
    {
      return false;
    }
  }

   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->

   * Return the total number of seats already booked on this trip.

   * 3. Return the total.
   * Related Features:
   * - bookings
   * - numberOfSeats
   * Related Classes: Booking
   * Input:
   * - None.
   * Output:
   * - int
   * - total count of booked seats.

   * - Trip exists.

   * Post-condition:

   * @model kind="operation"
   *        annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public int getBookedSeats()
  {
    int total = 0;
    if (bookings != null)
    {
      for (Booking booking : bookings)
      {
        if (booking != null)
        {
          total += booking.getNumberOfSeats();
        }
      }
    }
    return total;
  }

```java
    if (membershipPackage == null || !membershipPackage.hasAward(Award.DISCOUNTS))

  {
```
```java
    if (customer == null || bookingTime == null)
    {
      return price;
    }
    MembershipPackage membershipPackage = customer.getMembershipPackage();
    if (membershipPackage == null || !membershipPackage.hasAward(Award.DISCOUNTS))

      return price;

      Calendar departureCalendar = Calendar.getInstance();
      departureCalendar.setTime(departureDate);

      String[] timeParts = departureTime.split(":");
      if (timeParts.length < 2)
      {

      }

      int depMinute = Integer.parseInt(timeParts[1].trim());

      departureCalendar.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);

      return price;
    }
```

```java
    if (membershipPackage == null || !membershipPackage.hasAward(Award.DISCOUNTS))
    {
      return price;
    }

    {
      return price;

      Calendar departureCalendar = Calendar.getInstance();
      departureCalendar.setTime(departureDate);

      String[] timeParts = departureTime.split(":");
      if (timeParts.length < 2)
      {
        return price;

      departureCalendar.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);

      if (diffMillis < 24L * 60L * 60L * 1000L)
      {
        return price;

      double discountedPrice = price * 0.8;
      return Math.round(discountedPrice * 10.0) / 10.0;
```

# Requirement
```text
Online Rideshare System (ORS) manages shared road trips between drivers and customers. Every user is identified by an id and also stores an email address and a phone number so that the platform can distinguish and contact the user.

A driver can publish trips. A trip records a departure station, an arrival station, the number of available seats, a departure date, a departure time, an arrival time, and a price. Trips can be direct or indirect. An indirect trip contains one or more stops, and each stop stores the name of its stop station.

A customer can create bookings for trips. A booking records the requested number of seats, the booking date, the related customer, and the related trip. A booking is valid only when the trip exists, enough seats are still available, the customer has no overlapping booking on the same day, and the booking is made more than two hours before the trip departure time. When a booking is accepted, the trip seat inventory must be reduced accordingly.

Customers may subscribe to a membership package. A membership package stores one or more rewards, and each reward is one of cashback, discounts, or points. A customer with a discount reward receives a 20 percent discount only when the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. A customer with a points reward earns 5 points per booked seat for bookings created within the requested month.

A driver may publish a new trip only when the proposed trip has a valid time window and does not overlap with the driver’s existing trips. Two indirect trips posted by the same driver are considered overlapping by stops when they share at least one stop station, and stop-name comparison is case-sensitive.
Functional requirement:
1. Validate Booking Eligibility.
The system shall determine whether a customer can book seats on a trip. The trip must exist, the trip must still have enough available seats, the requested seats must not exceed the remaining seats, and the customer must not already hold another booking whose trip time overlaps on the same day. The booking time must be strictly earlier than the departure time by more than two hours, so a booking made exactly two hours before departure is rejected. When the booking is accepted, the trip seat count shall be reduced. Invalid inputs such as a null customer, null trip, or null booking date shall return `false`.

2. Calculate Discounted Trip Price.
The system shall calculate the final price of a booking after reward evaluation. A fixed 20 percent discount applies only when the customer owns a membership package containing the `DISCOUNTS` award and the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. The returned amount shall keep one decimal place. When the customer, membership package, booking time, or reward condition is invalid or missing, the original trip price shall be returned.

3. Check Stop Overlap for Indirect Trips.
The system shall determine whether two indirect trips posted by the same driver share at least one common stop station. The comparison is case-sensitive. If either trip is null or one of the stop collections is empty, the result shall be `false`.

4. Compute Monthly Reward Points.
The system shall compute the reward points earned by a customer during a given month. Only customers whose membership package contains the `POINTS` award are eligible. Only bookings whose booking date falls inside the requested month shall be counted. Each booked seat contributes 5 points. Invalid inputs, missing membership packages, or unsupported rewards shall return `0`.

5. Validate Trip Posting Feasibility.
The system shall validate whether a driver can publish a new trip. The proposed trip must exist, its departure time and arrival time must be valid, and the departure time must be earlier than the arrival time. The new trip must not overlap with any existing trip of the driver. Completely identical time periods are conflicts, while adjacent boundaries where one trip ends exactly when another starts are allowed. Invalid inputs shall return `false`.
```

# Requirement
```text
Online Rideshare System (ORS) manages shared road trips between drivers and customers. Every user is identified by an id and also stores an email address and a phone number so that the platform can distinguish and contact the user.

A driver can publish trips. A trip records a departure station, an arrival station, the number of available seats, a departure date, a departure time, an arrival time, and a price. Trips can be direct or indirect. An indirect trip contains one or more stops, and each stop stores the name of its stop station.

A customer can create bookings for trips. A booking records the requested number of seats, the booking date, the related customer, and the related trip. A booking is valid only when the trip exists, enough seats are still available, the customer has no overlapping booking on the same day, and the booking is made more than two hours before the trip departure time. When a booking is accepted, the trip seat inventory must be reduced accordingly.

Customers may subscribe to a membership package. A membership package stores one or more rewards, and each reward is one of cashback, discounts, or points. A customer with a discount reward receives a 20 percent discount only when the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. A customer with a points reward earns 5 points per booked seat for bookings created within the requested month.

A driver may publish a new trip only when the proposed trip has a valid time window and does not overlap with the driver’s existing trips. Two indirect trips posted by the same driver are considered overlapping by stops when they share at least one stop station, and stop-name comparison is case-sensitive.
Functional requirement:
1. Validate Booking Eligibility.
The system shall determine whether a customer can book seats on a trip. The trip must exist, the trip must still have enough available seats, the requested seats must not exceed the remaining seats, and the customer must not already hold another booking whose trip time overlaps on the same day. The booking time must be strictly earlier than the departure time by more than two hours, so a booking made exactly two hours before departure is rejected. When the booking is accepted, the trip seat count shall be reduced. Invalid inputs such as a null customer, null trip, or null booking date shall return `false`.

2. Calculate Discounted Trip Price.
The system shall calculate the final price of a booking after reward evaluation. A fixed 20 percent discount applies only when the customer owns a membership package containing the `DISCOUNTS` award and the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. The returned amount shall keep one decimal place. When the customer, membership package, booking time, or reward condition is invalid or missing, the original trip price shall be returned.

3. Check Stop Overlap for Indirect Trips.
The system shall determine whether two indirect trips posted by the same driver share at least one common stop station. The comparison is case-sensitive. If either trip is null or one of the stop collections is empty, the result shall be `false`.

4. Compute Monthly Reward Points.
The system shall compute the reward points earned by a customer during a given month. Only customers whose membership package contains the `POINTS` award are eligible. Only bookings whose booking date falls inside the requested month shall be counted. Each booked seat contributes 5 points. Invalid inputs, missing membership packages, or unsupported rewards shall return `0`.

5. Validate Trip Posting Feasibility.
The system shall validate whether a driver can publish a new trip. The proposed trip must exist, its departure time and arrival time must be valid, and the departure time must be earlier than the arrival time. The new trip must not overlap with any existing trip of the driver. Completely identical time periods are conflicts, while adjacent boundaries where one trip ends exactly when another starts are allowed. Invalid inputs shall return `false`.
```

# Operation Specifications
Booking::updateTripSeats
Summary:
Reduces the booked trip’s available seat inventory by this booking’s requested seat count.
Algorithm:
1. If customer or trip is null, do nothing.
2. Call trip.bookSeats(numberOfSeats).
3. If the trip accepts the booking, the trip’s remaining seats are reduced accordingly.
4. If the trip cannot accept the booking, leave state unchanged.
Related Features:
- numberOfSeats
- trip
Related Classes:
- Trip
Input:
- None directly; uses this booking’s numberOfSeats and trip.
Output:
- void.
Pre-condition:
- This booking has passed eligibility checks.
- trip is non-null and has enough remaining seats.
Post-condition:
- On success, the trip’s available seat count is decreased by numberOfSeats.
- On failure, no state change occurs.

# Operation Specifications
Booking::updateTripSeats
Summary:
Reduces the booked trip’s available seat inventory by this booking’s requested seat count.
Algorithm:
1. If customer or trip is null, do nothing.
2. Call trip.bookSeats(numberOfSeats).
3. If the trip accepts the booking, the trip’s remaining seats are reduced accordingly.
4. If the trip cannot accept the booking, leave state unchanged.
Related Features:
- numberOfSeats
- trip
Related Classes:
- Trip
Input:
- None directly; uses this booking’s numberOfSeats and trip.
Output:
- void.
Pre-condition:
- This booking has passed eligibility checks.
- trip is non-null and has enough remaining seats.
Post-condition:
- On success, the trip’s available seat count is decreased by numberOfSeats.
- On failure, no state change occurs.

Booking::isInMonth
Summary:
Checks whether this booking’s booking date falls within the specified month.
Algorithm:
1. If month is null or empty, return false.
2. If bookingDate is null, return false.
3. Compare the month portion of bookingDate with the requested month string.
4. Return true if they match; otherwise false.
Related Features:
- bookingDate
Related Classes:
- EDate
Input:
- month: String, a month identifier such as "YYYY-MM" or another project-defined month format.
- bookingDate: EDate, must be non-null for a meaningful result.
Output:
- boolean.
- true if bookingDate is inside the specified month.
- false otherwise.
Pre-condition:
- month is provided in the supported month format.
- bookingDate is initialized.
Post-condition:
- No state is modified.

Booking::overlapsWith
Summary:
Determines whether this booking overlaps with the schedule of another trip on the same day.
Algorithm:
1. If trip is null, return false.
2. If this booking’s trip or the given trip lacks valid date/time information, return false.
3. Compare the departure dates:
   - If not the same day, return false.
4. Determine the time window for both trips.
5. Return true if the two trip time intervals overlap.
   - Exact boundary touching is not considered overlap if one ends exactly when the other starts.
Related Features:
- trip
- bookingDate
Related Classes:
- Trip
- EDate
Input:
- trip: Trip, the trip to compare against; must be non-null for a valid comparison.
Output:
- boolean.
- true if the trips overlap on the same day.
- false otherwise.
Pre-condition:
- This booking contains a non-null trip with valid date/time.
- The argument trip contains valid date/time.
Post-condition:
- No state is modified.

Booking::isBookingEligible
Summary:
Determines whether this booking request is valid and can be accepted under the rideshare rules.
Algorithm:
1. If bookingDate, customer, or trip is null, return false.
2. Verify that the trip exists and has a valid departure date/time context.
3. Check that requested numberOfSeats is positive.
4. Compute remaining seats on the trip using trip.numberOfSeats - trip.getBookedSeats().
5. If requested seats exceed remaining seats, return false.
6. Ensure the booking is made strictly more than 2 hours before the trip departure time on the trip departure date.
7. Check the customer’s existing bookings:
   - For each existing booking belonging to the customer, if it is on the same day and overlaps with this trip, return false.
8. If all checks pass, return true.
Related Features:
- bookingDate
- numberOfSeats
- customer
- trip
- overlapsWith(trip)
- updateTripSeats()
Related Classes:
- Customer
- Trip
- Booking
- EDate
Input:
- None directly; uses the current Booking instance fields:
  - bookingDate: EDate, must be non-null.
  - numberOfSeats: int, must be greater than 0.
  - customer: Customer, must be non-null.
  - trip: Trip, must be non-null.
- Assumes trip departure date/time and existing customer bookings are available.
Output:
- boolean.
- true if this booking is eligible and can be accepted.
- false otherwise.
Pre-condition:
- bookingDate, customer, and trip are initialized.
- trip has valid departureDate and departureTime data.
- numberOfSeats is a positive integer.
Post-condition:
- No persistent state is changed by validation alone.
- If true is returned, the booking may later be accepted and trip seats reduced via updateTripSeats().

# Requirement
```text
Online Rideshare System (ORS) manages shared road trips between drivers and customers. Every user is identified by an id and also stores an email address and a phone number so that the platform can distinguish and contact the user.

A driver can publish trips. A trip records a departure station, an arrival station, the number of available seats, a departure date, a departure time, an arrival time, and a price. Trips can be direct or indirect. An indirect trip contains one or more stops, and each stop stores the name of its stop station.

A customer can create bookings for trips. A booking records the requested number of seats, the booking date, the related customer, and the related trip. A booking is valid only when the trip exists, enough seats are still available, the customer has no overlapping booking on the same day, and the booking is made more than two hours before the trip departure time. When a booking is accepted, the trip seat inventory must be reduced accordingly.

Customers may subscribe to a membership package. A membership package stores one or more rewards, and each reward is one of cashback, discounts, or points. A customer with a discount reward receives a 20 percent discount only when the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. A customer with a points reward earns 5 points per booked seat for bookings created within the requested month.

A driver may publish a new trip only when the proposed trip has a valid time window and does not overlap with the driver’s existing trips. Two indirect trips posted by the same driver are considered overlapping by stops when they share at least one stop station, and stop-name comparison is case-sensitive.
Functional requirement:
1. Validate Booking Eligibility.
The system shall determine whether a customer can book seats on a trip. The trip must exist, the trip must still have enough available seats, the requested seats must not exceed the remaining seats, and the customer must not already hold another booking whose trip time overlaps on the same day. The booking time must be strictly earlier than the departure time by more than two hours, so a booking made exactly two hours before departure is rejected. When the booking is accepted, the trip seat count shall be reduced. Invalid inputs such as a null customer, null trip, or null booking date shall return `false`.

2. Calculate Discounted Trip Price.
The system shall calculate the final price of a booking after reward evaluation. A fixed 20 percent discount applies only when the customer owns a membership package containing the `DISCOUNTS` award and the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. The returned amount shall keep one decimal place. When the customer, membership package, booking time, or reward condition is invalid or missing, the original trip price shall be returned.

3. Check Stop Overlap for Indirect Trips.
The system shall determine whether two indirect trips posted by the same driver share at least one common stop station. The comparison is case-sensitive. If either trip is null or one of the stop collections is empty, the result shall be `false`.

4. Compute Monthly Reward Points.
The system shall compute the reward points earned by a customer during a given month. Only customers whose membership package contains the `POINTS` award are eligible. Only bookings whose booking date falls inside the requested month shall be counted. Each booked seat contributes 5 points. Invalid inputs, missing membership packages, or unsupported rewards shall return `0`.

5. Validate Trip Posting Feasibility.
The system shall validate whether a driver can publish a new trip. The proposed trip must exist, its departure time and arrival time must be valid, and the departure time must be earlier than the arrival time. The new trip must not overlap with any existing trip of the driver. Completely identical time periods are conflicts, while adjacent boundaries where one trip ends exactly when another starts are allowed. Invalid inputs shall return `false`.
```

# Operation Specifications
Trip::isTimeConflicting
Summary:
Determines whether a proposed time window conflicts with this trip’s time window.
Algorithm:
1. If newDepartureTime or newArrivalTime is null, return false.
2. If this trip has invalid departureTime or arrivalTime, return false.
3. Interpret both this trip and the proposed trip as time intervals on the same day.
4. Return true if intervals overlap with positive duration.
   - Identical intervals are conflicts.
   - If one trip ends exactly when the other starts, return false.
5. Otherwise return false.
Related Features:
- departureTime
- arrivalTime
Related Classes:
- None
Input:
- newDepartureTime: String, proposed departure time, in a valid time format.
- newArrivalTime: String, proposed arrival time, in a valid time format.
Output:
- boolean.
- true if the proposed interval conflicts with this trip.
- false otherwise.
Pre-condition:
- This trip has valid departureTime and arrivalTime.
- Input times are parseable and represent a valid interval.
Post-condition:
- No state is modified.

Trip::getBookedSeats
Summary:
Returns the total number of seats already reserved on this trip.
Algorithm:
1. If bookings is null or empty, return 0.
2. Sum numberOfSeats over all bookings in bookings.
3. Return the total.
Related Features:
- bookings
- numberOfSeats
Related Classes:
- Booking
Input:
- None.
Output:
- int.
- Total booked seats for this trip, always non-negative.
Pre-condition:
- bookings collection is readable.
Post-condition:
- No state is modified.

Trip::bookSeats
Summary:
Reserves seats on this trip by reducing the remaining seat inventory.
Algorithm:
1. If num <= 0, return false.
2. Compute remaining seats as numberOfSeats - getBookedSeats().
3. If num is greater than remaining seats, return false.
4. Reduce the trip’s available inventory by num.
5. Return true.
Related Features:
- numberOfSeats
- bookings
Related Classes:
- Booking
Input:
- num: int, requested seats to reserve; must be greater than 0.
Output:
- boolean.
- true if seats were successfully reserved.
- false otherwise.
Pre-condition:
- numberOfSeats is initialized.
- Existing bookings accurately reflect already reserved seats.
Post-condition:
- On success, the trip’s available seats decrease by num.
- On failure, no state change occurs.

Trip::calculateDiscountedPrice
Summary:
Computes the final booking price after applying eligible membership discounts.
Algorithm:
1. If customer or bookingTime is null, return price.
2. If customer or customer.membershipPackage is null, return price.
3. Check whether membershipPackage has Award.DISCOUNTS.
   - If not, return price.
4. Determine whether bookingTime is at least 24 hours before this trip’s departure date/time.
5. If not eligible, return price.
6. Compute discountedPrice = price * 0.8.
7. Round the result to one decimal place.
8. Return discountedPrice.
Related Features:
- price
- departureDate
- departureTime
Related Classes:
- Customer
- MembershipPackage
- Award
- EDate
Input:
- customer: Customer, booking owner; must be non-null for discount evaluation.
- bookingTime: String, the booking timestamp used for the 24-hour rule.
Output:
- double.
- Final price after discount, rounded to one decimal place.
- If any condition is invalid or missing, returns the original trip price.
Pre-condition:
- price is initialized and non-negative.
- departureDate and departureTime are valid.
- bookingTime uses a supported date-time format.
Post-condition:
- No state is modified.

Trip::getStopStations
Summary:
Returns the ordered list of stop station names for this trip.
Algorithm:
1. If stops is null or empty, return an empty list.
2. Create an output list of strings.
3. For each stop in stops, append stop.stopStation to the output list.
4. Return the output list.
Related Features:
- stops
Related Classes:
- Stop
Input:
- None.
Output:
- List<String>.
- A list of stop station names in trip stop order.
- May be empty if there are no stops.
Pre-condition:
- stops collection is readable.
Post-condition:
- No state is modified.

Trip::calculateMonthlyPoints
Summary:
Computes the reward points generated by a customer’s bookings on this trip during a given month.
Algorithm:
1. If customer or currentMonth is null, return 0.
2. If customer membershipPackage is null, return 0.
3. Ensure the membership package has Award.POINTS; otherwise return 0.
4. Initialize total = 0.
5. For each booking in bookings:
   - If booking.customer equals the given customer and booking.isInMonth(currentMonth) is true,
     add booking.numberOfSeats * 5 to total.
6. Return total.
Related Features:
- bookings
- price
- departureDate
- departureTime
Related Classes:
- Booking
- Customer
- MembershipPackage
- Award
Input:
- customer: Customer, whose bookings are evaluated; must be non-null.
- currentMonth: String, month identifier such as "YYYY-MM".
Output:
- int.
- Total points earned from this trip in the specified month.
- Returns 0 for invalid input or unsupported reward.
Pre-condition:
- bookings list is initialized.
- customer and month are valid.
Post-condition:
- No state is modified.

1. If bookings is null or empty, return 0.
2. Sum numberOfSeats over all bookings in bookings.
3. Return the total.
Related Features:
- bookings
- numberOfSeats
Related Classes:
- Booking
Input:
- None.
Output:
- int.
- Total booked seats for this trip, always non-negative.
Pre-condition:
- bookings collection is readable.
Post-condition:
- No state is modified.

Trip::bookSeats
Summary:
Reserves seats on this trip by reducing the remaining seat inventory.
Algorithm:
1. If num <= 0, return false.
2. Compute remaining seats as numberOfSeats - getBookedSeats().
3. If num is greater than remaining seats, return false.
4. Reduce the trip’s available inventory by num.
5. Return true.
Related Features:
- numberOfSeats
- bookings
Related Classes:
- Booking
Input:
- num: int, requested seats to reserve; must be greater than 0.
Output:
- boolean.
- true if seats were successfully reserved.
- false otherwise.
Pre-condition:
- numberOfSeats is initialized.
- Existing bookings accurately reflect already reserved seats.
Post-condition:
- On success, the trip’s available seats decrease by num.
- On failure, no state change occurs.

Trip::calculateDiscountedPrice
Summary:
Computes the final booking price after applying eligible membership discounts.
Algorithm:
1. If customer or bookingTime is null, return price.
2. If customer or customer.membershipPackage is null, return price.
3. Check whether membershipPackage has Award.DISCOUNTS.
   - If not, return price.
4. Determine whether bookingTime is at least 24 hours before this trip’s departure date/time.
5. If not eligible, return price.
6. Compute discountedPrice = price * 0.8.
7. Round the result to one decimal place.
8. Return discountedPrice.
Related Features:
- price
- departureDate
- departureTime
Related Classes:
- Customer
- MembershipPackage
- Award
- EDate
Input:
- customer: Customer, booking owner; must be non-null for discount evaluation.
- bookingTime: String, the booking timestamp used for the 24-hour rule.
Output:
- double.
- Final price after discount, rounded to one decimal place.
- If any condition is invalid or missing, returns the original trip price.
Pre-condition:
- price is initialized and non-negative.
- departureDate and departureTime are valid.
- bookingTime uses a supported date-time format.
Post-condition:
- No state is modified.

Trip::getStopStations
Summary:
Returns the ordered list of stop station names for this trip.
Algorithm:
1. If stops is null or empty, return an empty list.
2. Create an output list of strings.
3. For each stop in stops, append stop.stopStation to the output list.
4. Return the output list.
Related Features:
- stops
Related Classes:
- Stop
Input:
- None.
Output:
- List<String>.
- A list of stop station names in trip stop order.
- May be empty if there are no stops.
Pre-condition:
- stops collection is readable.
Post-condition:
- No state is modified.

Trip::calculateMonthlyPoints
Summary:
Computes the reward points generated by a customer’s bookings on this trip during a given month.
Algorithm:
1. If customer or currentMonth is null, return 0.
2. If customer membershipPackage is null, return 0.
3. Ensure the membership package has Award.POINTS; otherwise return 0.
4. Initialize total = 0.
5. For each booking in bookings:
   - If booking.customer equals the given customer and booking.isInMonth(currentMonth) is true,
     add booking.numberOfSeats * 5 to total.
6. Return total.
Related Features:
- bookings
- price
- departureDate
- departureTime
Related Classes:
- Booking
- Customer
- MembershipPackage
- Award
Input:
- customer: Customer, whose bookings are evaluated; must be non-null.
- currentMonth: String, month identifier such as "YYYY-MM".
Output:
- int.
- Total points earned from this trip in the specified month.
- Returns 0 for invalid input or unsupported reward.
Pre-condition:
- bookings list is initialized.
- customer and month are valid.
Post-condition:
- No state is modified.

# Requirement
```text
Online Rideshare System (ORS) manages shared road trips between drivers and customers. Every user is identified by an id and also stores an email address and a phone number so that the platform can distinguish and contact the user.

A driver can publish trips. A trip records a departure station, an arrival station, the number of available seats, a departure date, a departure time, an arrival time, and a price. Trips can be direct or indirect. An indirect trip contains one or more stops, and each stop stores the name of its stop station.

A customer can create bookings for trips. A booking records the requested number of seats, the booking date, the related customer, and the related trip. A booking is valid only when the trip exists, enough seats are still available, the customer has no overlapping booking on the same day, and the booking is made more than two hours before the trip departure time. When a booking is accepted, the trip seat inventory must be reduced accordingly.

Customers may subscribe to a membership package. A membership package stores one or more rewards, and each reward is one of cashback, discounts, or points. A customer with a discount reward receives a 20 percent discount only when the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. A customer with a points reward earns 5 points per booked seat for bookings created within the requested month.

A driver may publish a new trip only when the proposed trip has a valid time window and does not overlap with the driver’s existing trips. Two indirect trips posted by the same driver are considered overlapping by stops when they share at least one stop station, and stop-name comparison is case-sensitive.
Functional requirement:
1. Validate Booking Eligibility.
The system shall determine whether a customer can book seats on a trip. The trip must exist, the trip must still have enough available seats, the requested seats must not exceed the remaining seats, and the customer must not already hold another booking whose trip time overlaps on the same day. The booking time must be strictly earlier than the departure time by more than two hours, so a booking made exactly two hours before departure is rejected. When the booking is accepted, the trip seat count shall be reduced. Invalid inputs such as a null customer, null trip, or null booking date shall return `false`.

2. Calculate Discounted Trip Price.
The system shall calculate the final price of a booking after reward evaluation. A fixed 20 percent discount applies only when the customer owns a membership package containing the `DISCOUNTS` award and the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. The returned amount shall keep one decimal place. When the customer, membership package, booking time, or reward condition is invalid or missing, the original trip price shall be returned.

3. Check Stop Overlap for Indirect Trips.
The system shall determine whether two indirect trips posted by the same driver share at least one common stop station. The comparison is case-sensitive. If either trip is null or one of the stop collections is empty, the result shall be `false`.

4. Compute Monthly Reward Points.
The system shall compute the reward points earned by a customer during a given month. Only customers whose membership package contains the `POINTS` award are eligible. Only bookings whose booking date falls inside the requested month shall be counted. Each booked seat contributes 5 points. Invalid inputs, missing membership packages, or unsupported rewards shall return `0`.

5. Validate Trip Posting Feasibility.
The system shall validate whether a driver can publish a new trip. The proposed trip must exist, its departure time and arrival time must be valid, and the departure time must be earlier than the arrival time. The new trip must not overlap with any existing trip of the driver. Completely identical time periods are conflicts, while adjacent boundaries where one trip ends exactly when another starts are allowed. Invalid inputs shall return `false`.
```

# Operation Specifications
Trip::isTimeConflicting
Summary:
Determines whether a proposed time window conflicts with this trip’s time window.
Algorithm:
1. If newDepartureTime or newArrivalTime is null, return false.
2. If this trip has invalid departureTime or arrivalTime, return false.
3. Interpret both this trip and the proposed trip as time intervals on the same day.
4. Return true if intervals overlap with positive duration.
   - Identical intervals are conflicts.
   - If one trip ends exactly when the other starts, return false.
5. Otherwise return false.
Related Features:
- departureTime
- arrivalTime
Related Classes:
- None
Input:
- newDepartureTime: String, proposed departure time, in a valid time format.
- newArrivalTime: String, proposed arrival time, in a valid time format.
Output:
- boolean.
- true if the proposed interval conflicts with this trip.
- false otherwise.
Pre-condition:
- This trip has valid departureTime and arrivalTime.
- Input times are parseable and represent a valid interval.
Post-condition:
- No state is modified.

Returns the ordered list of stop station names for this trip.
Algorithm:
1. If stops is null or empty, return an empty list.
2. Create an output list of strings.
3. For each stop in stops, append stop.stopStation to the output list.
4. Return the output list.
Related Features:
- stops
Related Classes:
- Stop
Input:
- None.
Output:
- List<String>.
- A list of stop station names in trip stop order.
- May be empty if there are no stops.
Pre-condition:
- stops collection is readable.
Post-condition:
- No state is modified.

Trip::calculateMonthlyPoints
Summary:
Computes the reward points generated by a customer’s bookings on this trip during a given month.
Algorithm:
1. If customer or currentMonth is null, return 0.
2. If customer membershipPackage is null, return 0.
3. Ensure the membership package has Award.POINTS; otherwise return 0.
4. Initialize total = 0.
5. For each booking in bookings:
   - If booking.customer equals the given customer and booking.isInMonth(currentMonth) is true,
     add booking.numberOfSeats * 5 to total.
6. Return total.
Related Features:
- bookings
- price
- departureDate
- departureTime
Related Classes:
- Booking
- Customer
- MembershipPackage
- Award
Input:
- customer: Customer, whose bookings are evaluated; must be non-null.
- currentMonth: String, month identifier such as "YYYY-MM".
Output:
- int.
- Total points earned from this trip in the specified month.
- Returns 0 for invalid input or unsupported reward.
Pre-condition:
- bookings list is initialized.
- customer and month are valid.
Post-condition:
- No state is modified.

# Requirement
```text
Online Rideshare System (ORS) manages shared road trips between drivers and customers. Every user is identified by an id and also stores an email address and a phone number so that the platform can distinguish and contact the user.

A driver can publish trips. A trip records a departure station, an arrival station, the number of available seats, a departure date, a departure time, an arrival time, and a price. Trips can be direct or indirect. An indirect trip contains one or more stops, and each stop stores the name of its stop station.

A customer can create bookings for trips. A booking records the requested number of seats, the booking date, the related customer, and the related trip. A booking is valid only when the trip exists, enough seats are still available, the customer has no overlapping booking on the same day, and the booking is made more than two hours before the trip departure time. When a booking is accepted, the trip seat inventory must be reduced accordingly.

Customers may subscribe to a membership package. A membership package stores one or more rewards, and each reward is one of cashback, discounts, or points. A customer with a discount reward receives a 20 percent discount only when the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. A customer with a points reward earns 5 points per booked seat for bookings created within the requested month.

A driver may publish a new trip only when the proposed trip has a valid time window and does not overlap with the driver’s existing trips. Two indirect trips posted by the same driver are considered overlapping by stops when they share at least one stop station, and stop-name comparison is case-sensitive.
Functional requirement:
1. Validate Booking Eligibility.
The system shall determine whether a customer can book seats on a trip. The trip must exist, the trip must still have enough available seats, the requested seats must not exceed the remaining seats, and the customer must not already hold another booking whose trip time overlaps on the same day. The booking time must be strictly earlier than the departure time by more than two hours, so a booking made exactly two hours before departure is rejected. When the booking is accepted, the trip seat count shall be reduced. Invalid inputs such as a null customer, null trip, or null booking date shall return `false`.

2. Calculate Discounted Trip Price.
The system shall calculate the final price of a booking after reward evaluation. A fixed 20 percent discount applies only when the customer owns a membership package containing the `DISCOUNTS` award and the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. The returned amount shall keep one decimal place. When the customer, membership package, booking time, or reward condition is invalid or missing, the original trip price shall be returned.

3. Check Stop Overlap for Indirect Trips.
The system shall determine whether two indirect trips posted by the same driver share at least one common stop station. The comparison is case-sensitive. If either trip is null or one of the stop collections is empty, the result shall be `false`.

4. Compute Monthly Reward Points.
The system shall compute the reward points earned by a customer during a given month. Only customers whose membership package contains the `POINTS` award are eligible. Only bookings whose booking date falls inside the requested month shall be counted. Each booked seat contributes 5 points. Invalid inputs, missing membership packages, or unsupported rewards shall return `0`.

5. Validate Trip Posting Feasibility.
The system shall validate whether a driver can publish a new trip. The proposed trip must exist, its departure time and arrival time must be valid, and the departure time must be earlier than the arrival time. The new trip must not overlap with any existing trip of the driver. Completely identical time periods are conflicts, while adjacent boundaries where one trip ends exactly when another starts are allowed. Invalid inputs shall return `false`.
```

# Operation Specifications
Driver::canPostTrip
Summary:
Validates whether the driver can publish a proposed new trip.
Algorithm:
1. If newtrip is null, return false.
2. Verify newtrip has valid departureDate, departureTime, arrivalTime, and numberOfSeats.
3. Ensure newtrip departureTime is earlier than arrivalTime.
4. For each existing trip in trips:
   - Use trip.isTimeConflicting(newtrip.departureTime, newtrip.arrivalTime).
   - If any conflict exists, return false.
5. If all checks pass, return true.
Related Features:
- trips
Related Classes:
- Trip
Input:
- newtrip: Trip, the proposed trip to publish; must be non-null.
Output:
- boolean.
- true if the trip can be published.
- false otherwise.
Pre-condition:
- Driver’s existing trips collection is initialized.
- Proposed trip contains valid time data.
Post-condition:
- No state is modified.
- A true result indicates the trip can be safely added to the driver’s trips.

Driver::checkStopOverlap
Summary:
Determines whether two indirect trips share at least one common stop station.
Algorithm:
1. If trip1 or trip2 is null, return false.
2. If either trip has no stops, return false.
3. Obtain the stop station names for both trips.
4. Compare every stop station in trip1 against every stop station in trip2.
5. If any exact case-sensitive match is found, return true.
6. Otherwise return false.
Related Features:
- trips
Related Classes:
- Trip
- Stop
Input:
- trip1: Trip, first indirect trip; must be non-null.
- trip2: Trip, second indirect trip; must be non-null.
Output:
- boolean.
- true if the two trips share at least one identical stop station name.
- false otherwise.
Pre-condition:
- Both trips are intended to be indirect trips with non-empty stop lists.
- Stop station names are available.
Post-condition:
- No state is modified.

The new trip must not overlap with any existing trip of the driver. Completely identical time periods are conflicts, while adjacent boundaries where one trip ends exactly when another starts are allowed. Invalid inputs shall return `false`.

# Operation Specifications
Customer::bookTrip
Summary:
Creates and records a booking for a customer on a trip, provided the booking is eligible.
Algorithm:
1. If trip is null or numberOfSeats <= 0, do nothing.
2. Create a new Booking instance and set:
   - customer = this
   - trip = trip
   - numberOfSeats = numberOfSeats
   - bookingDate = current system booking date/time as EDate-equivalent
3. Call booking.isBookingEligible().
4. If not eligible, discard the booking and stop.
5. If eligible, add booking to this bookings list and to trip.bookings list.
6. Call booking.updateTripSeats() to reduce trip inventory.
Related Features:
- bookings
- membershipPackage
Related Classes:
- Booking
- Trip
Input:
- trip: Trip, target trip; must be non-null.
- numberOfSeats: int, requested seats; must be greater than 0.
Output:
- void.
Pre-condition:
- Customer exists.
- trip exists.
- Requested seats are positive.
- System can determine the booking date/time.
Post-condition:
- If eligible, a booking is added to customer and trip booking collections.
- Trip seat inventory is reduced by the booked seats.
- If not eligible, no booking is created.

Customer::computeMonthlyRewardPoints
Summary:
Computes the total reward points earned by this customer in the specified month.
Algorithm:
1. If currentMonth is null or empty, return 0.
2. If membershipPackage is null, return 0.
3. Verify the membership package contains Award.POINTS.
   - If not, return 0.
4. Initialize totalPoints = 0.
5. For each booking in bookings:
   - If booking.isInMonth(currentMonth) is true, add booking.numberOfSeats * 5 to totalPoints.
6. Return totalPoints.
Related Features:
- bookings
- membershipPackage
Related Classes:
- Booking
- MembershipPackage
- Award
Input:
- currentMonth: String, month identifier to evaluate, e.g. "YYYY-MM".
Output:
- int.
- Total reward points for bookings in the month.
- Returns 0 if inputs are invalid, membership is missing, or POINTS award is absent.
Pre-condition:
- bookings list is initialized.
- currentMonth uses the supported month format.
Post-condition:
- No persistent state is changed.

# Requirement
```text
Online Rideshare System (ORS) manages shared road trips between drivers and customers. Every user is identified by an id and also stores an email address and a phone number so that the platform can distinguish and contact the user.

A driver can publish trips. A trip records a departure station, an arrival station, the number of available seats, a departure date, a departure time, an arrival time, and a price. Trips can be direct or indirect. An indirect trip contains one or more stops, and each stop stores the name of its stop station.

A customer can create bookings for trips. A booking records the requested number of seats, the booking date, the related customer, and the related trip. A booking is valid only when the trip exists, enough seats are still available, the customer has no overlapping booking on the same day, and the booking is made more than two hours before the trip departure time. When a booking is accepted, the trip seat inventory must be reduced accordingly.

Customers may subscribe to a membership package. A membership package stores one or more rewards, and each reward is one of cashback, discounts, or points. A customer with a discount reward receives a 20 percent discount only when the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. A customer with a points reward earns 5 points per booked seat for bookings created within the requested month.

A driver may publish a new trip only when the proposed trip has a valid time window and does not overlap with the driver’s existing trips. Two indirect trips posted by the same driver are considered overlapping by stops when they share at least one stop station, and stop-name comparison is case-sensitive.
Functional requirement:
1. Validate Booking Eligibility.
The system shall determine whether a customer can book seats on a trip. The trip must exist, the trip must still have enough available seats, the requested seats must not exceed the remaining seats, and the customer must not already hold another booking whose trip time overlaps on the same day. The booking time must be strictly earlier than the departure time by more than two hours, so a booking made exactly two hours before departure is rejected. When the booking is accepted, the trip seat count shall be reduced. Invalid inputs such as a null customer, null trip, or null booking date shall return `false`.

2. Calculate Discounted Trip Price.
The system shall calculate the final price of a booking after reward evaluation. A fixed 20 percent discount applies only when the customer owns a membership package containing the `DISCOUNTS` award and the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. The returned amount shall keep one decimal place. When the customer, membership package, booking time, or reward condition is invalid or missing, the original trip price shall be returned.

3. Check Stop Overlap for Indirect Trips.
The system shall determine whether two indirect trips posted by the same driver share at least one common stop station. The comparison is case-sensitive. If either trip is null or one of the stop collections is empty, the result shall be `false`.

4. Compute Monthly Reward Points.
The system shall compute the reward points earned by a customer during a given month. Only customers whose membership package contains the `POINTS` award are eligible. Only bookings whose booking date falls inside the requested month shall be counted. Each booked seat contributes 5 points. Invalid inputs, missing membership packages, or unsupported rewards shall return `0`.

5. Validate Trip Posting Feasibility.
The system shall validate whether a driver can publish a new trip. The proposed trip must exist, its departure time and arrival time must be valid, and the departure time must be earlier than the arrival time. The new trip must not overlap with any existing trip of the driver. Completely identical time periods are conflicts, while adjacent boundaries where one trip ends exactly when another starts are allowed. Invalid inputs shall return `false`.
```

# Operation Specifications
MembershipPackage::hasAward
Summary:
Checks whether this membership package contains a specific reward award.
Algorithm:
1. If award is null, return false.
2. If awards list is null or empty, return false.
3. Search the awards list for the given award.
4. Return true if found; otherwise false.
Related Features:
- awards
- customer
Related Classes:
- Award
Input:
- award: Award enum value to look for; must be non-null.
Output:
- boolean.
- true if the award is included in the package.
- false otherwise.
Pre-condition:
- awards collection is initialized or safely readable.
Post-condition:
- No state is modified.

  public int computeMonthlyRewardPoints(final String currentMonth)
  {
    if (currentMonth == null || currentMonth.length() == 0)
    {
      return 0;
    }

    if (membershipPackage == null || !membershipPackage.hasAward(Award.POINTS))
    {
      return 0;
    }

    int totalPoints = 0;
    for (Booking booking : getBookings())
    {
      if (booking != null && booking.isInMonth(currentMonth))
      {
        totalPoints += booking.getNumberOfSeats() * 5;
      }
    }
    return totalPoints;
    
  }

    booking.setCustomer(this);
    booking.setTrip(trip);

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   * Computes the final booking price after applying eligible membership discounts.
   * Algorithm:
   * 1. If customer or bookingTime is null, return price.
   * 2. If customer or customer.membershipPackage is null, return price.
   * 3. Check whether membershipPackage has Award.DISCOUNTS.
   *    - If not, return price.
   * 4. Determine whether bookingTime is at least 24 hours before this trip’s departure date/time.
   * 5. If not eligible, return price.
   * 6. Compute discountedPrice = price * 0.8.
   * 7. Round the result to one decimal place.
   * 8. Return discountedPrice.
   * Related Features:
   * - price
   * - departureDate
   * - departureTime
   * Related Classes:
   * - Customer
   * - MembershipPackage
   * - Award
   * - EDate
   * Input:
   * - customer: Customer, booking owner; must be non-null for discount evaluation.
   * - bookingTime: String, the booking timestamp used for the 24-hour rule.
   * Output:
   * - double.
   * - Final price after discount, rounded to one decimal place.
   * - If any condition is invalid or missing, returns the original trip price.
   * Pre-condition:
   * - price is initialized and non-negative.
   * - departureDate and departureTime are valid.
   * - bookingTime uses a supported date-time format.
   * Post-condition:
   * - No state is modified.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public double calculateDiscountedPrice(final Customer customer, final String bookingTime)
  {
    if (customer == null || bookingTime == null)
    {
      return price;
    }
    MembershipPackage membershipPackage = customer.getMembershipPackage();
    if (membershipPackage == null || !membershipPackage.hasAward(Award.DISCOUNTS))
    {
      return price;
    }
    if (departureDate == null || departureTime == null)
    {
      return price;
    }

    try
    {
      String datePart = departureDate.toString();
      java.text.SimpleDateFormat sdf = new java.text.SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm");
      sdf.setLenient(false);

      java.util.Date bookingDateTime = sdf.parse(bookingTime);
      java.util.Date departureDateTime = sdf.parse(datePart + " " + departureTime);

      long diffMillis = departureDateTime.getTime() - bookingDateTime.getTime();
      if (diffMillis < 24L * 60L * 60L * 1000L)
      {
        return price;
      }

      double discountedPrice = price * 0.8;
      return Math.round(discountedPrice * 10.0) / 10.0;
    }
    catch (Exception e)
    {
      return price;
    }
    
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   * Computes the reward points earned by a customer from bookings on this trip during a given month.
   * Algorithm:
   * 1. If customer or currentMonth is null, return 0.
   * 2. If customer.membershipPackage is null, return 0.
   * 3. If customer.membershipPackage does not contain Award.POINTS, return 0.
   * 4. Initialize total = 0.
   * 5. For each booking in bookings:
   *    - If booking.customer equals the given customer and booking.isInMonth(currentMonth) is true,
   *      add booking.numberOfSeats * 5 to total.
   * 6. Return total.
   * Related Features:
   * - bookings
   * Related Classes:
   * - Booking
   * - Customer
   * - MembershipPackage
   * - Award
   * Input:
   * - customer: Customer, the customer whose points are calculated; must be non-null.
   * - currentMonth: String, the target month identifier, typically in "YYYY-MM" format.
   * Output:
   * - int.
   * - Total points earned from eligible bookings on this trip in the specified month.
   * - Returns 0 for invalid input or unsupported reward.
   * Pre-condition:
   * - bookings collection is readable.
   * - currentMonth is a supported month format.
   * Post-condition:
   * - No state is modified.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public int calculateMonthlyPoints(final Customer customer, final String currentMonth)
  {
    if (customer == null || currentMonth == null)
    {
      return 0;
    }
    MembershipPackage membershipPackage = customer.getMembershipPackage();
    if (membershipPackage == null || !membershipPackage.hasAward(Award.POINTS))
    {
      return 0;
    }

    int total = 0;
    if (bookings != null)
    {
      for (Booking booking : bookings)
      {
        if (booking != null && customer.equals(booking.getCustomer()) && booking.isInMonth(currentMonth))
        {
          total += booking.getNumberOfSeats() * 5;
        }
      }
    }
    return total;
    
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->

   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   * Reserves seats on this trip when the requested number is valid and sufficient inventory remains.
   * Algorithm:
   * 1. If num <= 0, return false.
   * 2. If this trip has no remaining seats or num is greater than the remaining seats, return false.
   * 3. Reduce the trip’s available seat inventory by num.
   * 4. Return true.
   * Related Features:
   * - numberOfSeats
   * Related Classes:
   * None
   * Input:
   * - num: int, requested number of seats to reserve; must be greater than 0.
   * Output:
   * - boolean.

   * - false otherwise.
   * Pre-condition:
   * - numberOfSeats is initialized and represents the current remaining seats.
   * Post-condition:

   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT

  public boolean bookSeats(final int num)
  {
    if (num <= 0 || numberOfSeats <= 0 || num > numberOfSeats)
    {
      return false;
    }
    numberOfSeats -= num;
    return true;
    
  }

   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   * Determines whether a proposed time window conflicts with this trip’s time window.
   * Algorithm:
   * 1. If newDepartureTime or newArrivalTime is null, return false.
   * 2. If this trip has invalid departureTime or arrivalTime, return false.
   * 3. Interpret both this trip and the proposed trip as time intervals on the same day.
   * 4. Return true if intervals overlap with positive duration.
   *    - Identical intervals are conflicts.
   *    - If one trip ends exactly when the other starts, return false.
   * 5. Otherwise return false.
   * Related Features:
   * - departureTime
   * - arrivalTime
   * Related Classes:
   * - None
   * Input:
   * - newDepartureTime: String, proposed departure time, in a valid time format.
   * - newArrivalTime: String, proposed arrival time, in a valid time format.
   * Output:
   * - boolean.
   * - true if the proposed interval conflicts with this trip.
   * - false otherwise.
   * Pre-condition:
   * - This trip has valid departureTime and arrivalTime.
   * - Input times are parseable and represent a valid interval.
   * Post-condition:
   * - No state is modified.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public boolean isTimeConflicting(final String newDepartureTime, final String newArrivalTime)
  {
    if (newDepartureTime == null || newArrivalTime == null || departureTime == null || arrivalTime == null)
    {
      return false;
    }

    try
    {
      java.text.SimpleDateFormat sdf = new java.text.SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm");
      sdf.setLenient(false);

      java.util.Date thisDeparture = sdf.parse(departureTime);
      java.util.Date thisArrival = sdf.parse(arrivalTime);
      java.util.Date proposedDeparture = sdf.parse(newDepartureTime);
      java.util.Date proposedArrival = sdf.parse(newArrivalTime);

      long thisStart = thisDeparture.getTime();
      long thisEnd = thisArrival.getTime();
      long proposedStart = proposedDeparture.getTime();
      long proposedEnd = proposedArrival.getTime();

      return thisStart < proposedEnd && proposedStart < thisEnd;
    }
    catch (Exception e)
    {
      return false;
    }
    
  }

  public int getBookedSeats()
  {

      return 0;

      if (booking != null)

        total += booking.getNumberOfSeats();

    }
    return total;
    
  }

```java
    {

    }
```

    }
    int remainingSeats = trip.getNumberOfSeats() - trip.getBookedSeats();
    if (numberOfSeats > remainingSeats)

    }

  private boolean sameDay(Date d1, Date d2)

  private long getDateTimeMillis(Date date, String time)
  {
    if (date == null || time == null)
    {
      return -1L;
    }
    String[] parts = time.trim().split(":");
    if (parts.length < 2)
    {
      return -1L;
    }
    try
    {
      int hour = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
      int minute = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
      Date combined = new Date(date.getTime());
      combined.setHours(hour);
      combined.setMinutes(minute);
      combined.setSeconds(0);
      return combined.getTime();
    }
    catch (NumberFormatException e)
    {
      return -1L;
    }
  }

  private String formatMonth(Date date)
  {
    int year = date.getYear() + 1900;
    int month = date.getMonth() + 1;
    return String.format("%04d-%02d", Integer.valueOf(year), Integer.valueOf(month));
  }
